# NHS

> England's National Health Service (NHS) provides comprehensive health information, service locators, and digital tools for accessing GP care, mental health support, pharmacies, and urgent care guidance.

The NHS website serves as the primary digital hub for health information and service access across England, integrating appointment booking, prescription management, test result viewing, and symptom assessment through NHS 111 and the NHS App.

## Key Topics

- NHS App
- GP surgery
- NHS 111
- NHS number
- Mental health services
- Talking therapies
- Online services
- Service locators
- NHS e-Referral Service
- Vaccinations
- Urgent care
- Self-referral
- Health A to Z
- NHS login
- England

## Core Services & Access

- [NHS website for England](https://www.nhs.uk): NHS homepage providing access to health information and services for England.
- [NHS services overview](https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services): Overview of NHS services including GPs, pharmacies, hospitals and online services.
- [Get help for your symptoms - NHS 111](https://111.nhs.uk): NHS 111 online symptom checker and urgent care triage service.
- [Find a GP](https://www.nhs.uk/service-search/find-a-gp): GP locator service displaying practices with opening times and ratings.
- [Find a pharmacy](https://www.nhs.uk/service-search/find-a-pharmacy): Pharmacy locator service showing opening times and facilities near you.
- [Find a dentist](https://www.nhs.uk/service-search/find-a-dentist): Dentist finder showing local practices with opening times and ratings.

## GP Management & Appointments

- [Appointments and bookings at your GP surgery](https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/gps/gp-appointments-and-bookings): How-to guide for booking, changing and cancelling GP appointments online.
- [Register with a GP surgery](https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/gps/how-to-register-with-a-gp-surgery): Instructions for registering with a GP surgery or changing GP in England.
- [View your GP health record](https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/gps/view-your-gp-health-record): How-to guide for viewing GP health records online via NHS App or website.

## Prescriptions & Test Results

- [How to order a repeat prescription](https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/prescriptions/how-to-order-a-repeat-prescription): Instructions for ordering repeat prescriptions through NHS App or GP services.
- [View your test results](https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/online-services/view-your-test-results): Guide to accessing test results online through NHS App and patient portal.
- [Find your NHS number](https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/online-services/find-nhs-number): Online service to retrieve NHS number via text, email or letter.

## Mental Health & Wellbeing

- [Mental health](https://www.nhs.uk/mental-health): Mental health hub with information, support and NHS talking therapies resources.
- [Find NHS talking therapies for anxiety and depression](https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/mental-health-services/find-nhs-talking-therapies-for-anxiety-and-depression): Self-referral guide to NHS talking therapies for anxiety and depression.
- [Healthy living](https://www.nhs.uk/live-well): NHS guidance on healthy living, diet, exercise, weight management and lifestyle.

## Health Information & Conditions

- [Health A to Z](https://www.nhs.uk/health-a-to-z): Comprehensive directory of health conditions, symptoms, medicines and treatments.
- [Colds, coughs and ear infections in children](https://www.nhs.uk/baby/health/colds-coughs-and-ear-infections-in-children): Symptoms and treatment guidance for childhood colds and ear infections.
- [Get NHS help for back or joint problems from community musculoskeletal (MSK) services](https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/get-nhs-help-for-back-joint-problems): Self-referral guide to NHS physiotherapy and MSK services for back and joint pain.

## Support & Seasonal Health

- [Social care and support guide](https://www.nhs.uk/social-care-and-support): Guide to social care and support options for illness, disability and caregiving.
- [Winter vaccinations and winter health](https://www.nhs.uk/live-well/seasonal-health/keep-warm-keep-well): NHS guidance on winter vaccinations and staying healthy during winter.
